title: Analog Output
text: Write to one or multiple analog output channels, 1 input, 1 output, {Block input signal} sets Value type sent into block; {Install new board} sets the register a board < no board, {Delete current board} sets the delete the current board, {Board setup} sets the up the board, {Sample time}, {Maximum missed ticks} sets the number of timer ticks by which your model can trail, {Show “Missed Ticks” port} sets the send number of missed ticks to port Missed, {Yield CPU when waiting} sets the yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware, {Output channels} sets the channel vector that selects output, {Output range} selects output range for analog outputs board, {Initial value} and {Final value}. Values come from the instance.
